title: Adhyātma Rāmāyaṇa
author: Bhagavān Veda Vyāsa (भगवान् वेदव्यासः)
description: The Adhyātma Rāmāyaṇa (part of the Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa) is the preeminent classical Sanskrit epic unifying Ramabhakti with unconditioned Advaita Vedānta. Narrated as a sacred dialogue between Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati, it unveils Śrī Rāma not merely as an epic hero, but as the unconditioned Para Brahman, and Sītā as Mūla-Prakṛti / Yoga-Māyā. Featuring the celebrated Rāma Hṛdaya and Rāma Gītā, this scripture serves as an indispensable compendium for the non-dual realization of Truth.
description_hindi: अध्यात्मरामायण ब्रह्माण्डपुराण का वह दिव्य अङ्ग है जिसमें रामकथा के माध्यम से विशुद्ध अद्वैत वेदान्त और अनन्य भक्तियोग का अनुपम समन्वय किया गया है। भगवान् शिव और देवी पार्वती के संवाद रूप में निबद्ध यह ग्रन्थ श्रीराम को परब्रह्म और सीता को मूलप्रकृति योगमाया के रूप में उद्घाटित करता है।

high_density_highlights.title: Rāma Hṛdaya (रामहृदयम्)
high_density_highlights.speaker: Śrī Mahādeva (Lord Shiva)
high_density_highlights.description: Lord Shiva reveals the esoteric essence of Rama to Parvati: Rama is the unconditioned Supreme Brahman, while Sita is Yoga-Maya creating, sustaining, and dissolving the cosmos in His presence.

high_density_highlights.title: Ahalyā Stuti (अहल्याकृत श्रीरामस्तुतिः)
high_density_highlights.speaker: Ahalyā
high_density_highlights.description: Upon being redeemed from her stony stupor by the touch of Rama's lotus feet, Ahalya offers a sublime Advaitic hymn praising Rama as the witness of all minds (Sarva-Sakshi).

high_density_highlights.title: Lakṣmaṇa-Upadeśa (लक्ष्मणोपदेशः - मायास्वरूपम्)
high_density_highlights.speaker: Śrī Rāma
high_density_highlights.description: When Lakshmana is overcome with anger at Rama's unjust exile, Rama pacifies him with a profound discourse on the illusory nature of anger, grief, and body-identification born of Maya.

high_density_highlights.title: Navavidhā Bhakti (शबरीं प्रति नवधाभक्तिनिरूपणम्)
high_density_highlights.speaker: Śrī Rāma
high_density_highlights.description: Rama instructs the elderly ascetic Shabari in the nine steps of devotion, establishing that sincere devotion is independent of caste, gender, or status, and naturally culminates in liberating gnosis.

high_density_highlights.title: Tārā-Prabodha (तारायै आत्मतत्त्वोपदेशः)
high_density_highlights.speaker: Śrī Rāma
high_density_highlights.doctrine: Deha-Atma-Viveka, Immortal Soul vs. Mortal Frame
high_density_highlights.description: As Tara weeps inconsolably over the slain Vali, Rama asks her: 'Whom do you mourn? The body made of five elements, or the conscious soul? The body is inert; the soul is immortal and unslain.'

high_density_highlights.title: Vibhīṣaṇa Śaraṇāgati (विभीषणशरणागतिः)
high_density_highlights.speaker: Śrī Rāma & Vibhīṣaṇa
high_density_highlights.description: The eternal proclamation of divine sanctuary: 'Even if Ravana himself comes seeking refuge, I shall grant him protection from all fears forever.'

high_density_highlights.title: Śrī Rāma Gītā (श्रीरामगीता - उत्तरकाण्डे पञ्चमः सर्गः)
high_density_highlights.speaker: Śrī Rāma
high_density_highlights.description: The supreme philosophical crest of the epic: Rama's definitive philosophical discourse to Lakshmana expounding the identity of Jiva and Brahman, the nature of Upadhis, negation through Neti-Neti, and the nature of the Jivanmukta.

high_density_highlights.title: Kausalyā Mokṣa (कौशल्यायै मुक्तिप्रदज्ञानोपदेशः)
high_density_highlights.speaker: Śrī Rāma
high_density_highlights.description: Rama consoles his grieving mother Kausalya with the secret of cosmic surrender and non-dual contemplation, leading her to direct liberation.

kandas.name: Bālakāṇḍa
kandas.summary: The advent of the Supreme Lord as Rama, the revelation of the transcendent mystery in Ramahridaya, redemption of Ahalya, bow of Shiva, and marriage with Sita as Yoga-Maya.
kandas.summary_hindi: भगवान् श्री राम का प्राकट्य, शिव-पार्वती संवाद में रामहृदय का परम अद्वैत उपदेश, अहल्या उद्धार, धनुर्भङ्ग तथा सीता के साथ परिणय।

sargas.title: Ramahridaya

Ahalyoddharana

kandas.name: Ayodhyākāṇḍa
kandas.summary: The divine conspiracy of exile, Lakshmana's philosophical instruction on Maya, meeting with Guha, crossing the Ganga, meeting with Bharadvaja, Valmiki's ashram, and the sandals of Rama.
kandas.summary_hindi: वनवास का दिव्य सङ्कल्प, लक्ष्मण को माया एवं विवेक का उपदेश, गुह-मिलन, भरत-मिलाप तथा पादुका-प्रदान।

Kaikeyi's demands and Rama's detached acceptance

kandas.name: Āraṇyakāṇḍa
kandas.summary: The forest hermitage, meeting with Sage Agastya, manifestation of the illusory Maya-Sita, abduction of the reflection, destruction of Jatayu, and Shabari's ninefold devotion (Navavidha Bhakti).
kandas.summary_hindi: दण्डकारण्य में मुनियों का दर्शन, अगस्त्य संवाद, माया-सीता का प्राकट्य, रावण द्वारा अपहरण, जटायु उद्धार एवं शबरी को नवधा भक्ति का उपदेश।

Agastya's Advaita discourse and the journey to Panchavati
Settling in Panchavati and Rama's teaching on Moksha to Lakshmana
Surpanakha's encounter and the annihilation of Khara
Ravana's plot and Maricha's warning

The search for Sita and Jatayu's liberation
Kabandha's encounter, liberation, and Virat Purusha stotra
Shabari's devotion, Navavidha Bhakti, and her liberation

kandas.name: Kiṣkindhākāṇḍa
kandas.summary: Meeting with Hanuman and Sugriva, slaying of Vali, Tara's supreme Advaita enlightenment by Rama, rainy season contemplation, and the search for Sita.
kandas.summary_hindi: हनुमान् व सुग्रीव मिलन, बालि वध, तारा को श्रीराम द्वारा आत्म-ज्ञान का उपदेश, चातुर्मास्य का ध्यान तथा सीता की खोज।

sargas.title: Meeting Hanuman and the alliance with Sugriva

The rainy season and Rama's teaching on Moksha to Lakshmana
Lakshmana's anger and the mobilization of the vanara army
Hanuman receives the ring and the encounter with Swayamprabha
Despair at the ocean and the arrival of Sampati
Sampati's backstory and the sage's teaching on the Atman
Jambavan awakens Hanuman's latent divine power

kandas.name: Sundarakāṇḍa
kandas.summary: Hanuman's oceanic leap of faith, discovery of Sita in Ashoka Vatika, delivery of the signet ring, Advaita discourse to Ravana, burning of Lanka, and report to Rama.
kandas.summary_hindi: हनुमान् जी का समुद्र-लङ्घन, अशोक वाटिका में सीता दर्शन, रावण को तत्त्व-उपदेश, लङ्का-दहन तथा श्रीराम को सन्देश-समर्पण।

Hanuman's return and report to Rama

kandas.name: Yuddhakāṇḍa
kandas.summary: March to the ocean, Vibhishana's surrender (Sharanagati), bridging the sea, cosmic battle, fall of Kumbhakarna and Ravana, fire-ordeal and retrieval of the real Sita, and the grand coronation at Ayodhya.
kandas.summary_hindi: सेतु-निर्माण, विभीषण शरणागति, महायुद्ध, कुम्भकर्ण व रावण का मोक्ष, माया-सीता का अग्नि-प्रवेश व वास्तविक सीता की पुनः प्राप्ति तथा भव्य राज्याभिषेक।

kandas.name: Uttarakāṇḍa
kandas.summary: The crowning crest of Advaita: Rama Gita (definitive instruction to Lakshmana), Sita's oath, Kausalya's liberation, Kala's arrival, Lakshmana's resumption of Shesha form, and Rama's entry into the Sarayu with cosmic liberation of Ayodhya.
